show config
site-to-site-vpn
 vpn ipsec 1
   name azure
   ike-version ikev2
   role initiator
   dead-peer-detection interval 30
   remote-address 198.51.100.9
   remote-id 198.51.100.9
   local-id 203.0.113.4
   force-encap
   remote-subnets 10.1.0.0/16
   local-subnets translation 10.1.3.0/24
   local-subnets translation 192.168.200.0/24
   local-subnets translation 192.168.10.1/24
   local-subnets translation 192.168.20.1/24
   remote-psk $crypt$1$REDACTED_FOR_TESTDATA
   local-psk $crypt$1$REDACTED_FOR_TESTDATA
   ike phase 1
      encryption aes256
      integrity sha256
      dh-group 14
      key-lifetime 2
      exit
   ike phase 2
      encryption aes256
      integrity sha256
      pfs dh-group 14
      key-lifetime 1
      exit
   exit
!
